  - Division 3 Vertical Limits of Deck of Shenzhen Section of Lok Ma Chau Bridge and Connecting Roads

    - 1. For the gantry section of the deck of the Shenzhen section of the Lok Ma Chau Bridge and the connecting roads—

      - (a) the upper vertical limit is +6.6 m above grade elevation; and

      - (b) the lower vertical limit is the surface on top of the box girder.

    - 2. For the portion of the at-grade section that underpasses the existing bridge section of the Shenzhen section of the Lok Ma Chau Bridge—

      - (a) the upper vertical limit is the external surface of the existing structure above the road; and

      - (b) the lower vertical limit is +3.62 m (1985 National Height Datum).

    - 3. For the remaining portion of the at-grade section excluding the portion that underpasses the existing bridge section of the Shenzhen section of the Lok Ma Chau Bridge—

      - (a) the upper vertical limit is +15 m above grade elevation; and

      - (b) the lower vertical limit is +3.62 m (1985 National Height Datum).

    - 4. For the bridge section with access to the interior of the box girder via the deck of the Shenzhen section of the Lok Ma Chau Bridge—

      - (a) the upper vertical limit is +15 m above grade elevation; and

      - (b) the lower vertical limit is the surface on top of the box girder, and the interior of the box girder accessible via the deck.

    - 5. For the remaining portion of the deck of the Shenzhen section of the Lok Ma Chau Bridge and the connecting roads other than the section or portion mentioned in section 1, 2, 3 or 4 of this Division—

      - (a) the upper vertical limit is +15 m above grade elevation; and

      - (b) the lower vertical limit is the surface on top of the box girder.
